script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: The text does not say that none of the cows were scared.
The wording says both dream events happened twice. Each happened in a separate dream.
The text says Pharaoh summoned help in the morning, not that he did so right away.
The text does not say Pharaoh had a restless night.
The explanation repeats the answer and calls it a list without adding much personality or insight.
The text does not say the magicians and wise men were the first people to hear the dreams.
The cupbearer does not thank Joseph aloud in this passage.
The quote uses “I” without introducing the cupbearer as its speaker.
Joseph is quickly brought out of the dungeon, but the text does not say he never spends another day there.
“The answer comes before any request” implies a later request that the text does not give.
Papa jokes about eating cows. The Scripture-food exception permits mentioning them as a Bible fact, not as food in his own joke.
The explanation repeats that Egypt is where events happen without adding much personality or insight.
The cold-oven comparison does not make it clear why a good batch would be forgotten.
The text says Pharaoh's spirit was troubled in the morning, not that he woke up shaken.
The text does not say Pharaoh had never told anyone about the first dream before the second one.
The explanation presents the grain as already gathered and stored when Joseph is proposing a plan.
